name: Iris
source:
★The mysterious headmistress of Wizardia Academy★

She is the headmistress of Wizardia Magic Academy. While she appears as a young girl, she is actually a highly skilled archmage.

She always maintains a detached aura and calmly watches over the growth of the girls at the academy. She usually leads a rather leisurely life, playing chess with Sieg or wandering around the academy with a bag of snacks in hand.

She seems to be interested in Tsukasa and occasionally tries to contact him.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/mwa/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
